steps.name: check-in report: the focus that started the experiment
metric info: serve count, toss height, spin (sample)
check this serve (annotation mode) on the imported serve
the report shows the radar reading as "Radar speed (you logged)"
skip set-up and import a 16-serve check-in
focus → drill → two practice logs (starts the experiment)
today and record show the re-test
import the re-test and see the verdict
skip set-up; the service worker takes control
load the sample (cached on first use)
T2: a third analysed day this month shows the allowance notice and the Plus preview
morning after a comp night: Today asks for the match log (U3)
match log: a comp night with counted first serves
the logged night clears the card; Profile lists the match log
progress: comp nights, and the season view (T3 preview; open in the beta)
compare view: the ghost overlay (T3 preview; open in the beta)
beta data: counts and the exported report
